personal_opinions.ai_coding: AI makes prototyping faster. It makes deciding what deserves production more important.
personal_opinions.automation: A business rarely needs ten more automations. It needs one broken handoff fixed.
personal_opinions.generated_code: Generated code is abundant. Clear requirements are scarce.
personal_opinions.manual_work: The cost of manual lead entry is not typing. It is delayed follow-up.
personal_opinions.ai_future: As AI coding becomes commonplace, system design and accountability matter more.
personal_opinions.monitoring: An automation without monitoring is a future support ticket.
personal_opinions.observation: A lead can arrive at midnight. Your follow-up process should not depend on someone being awake.
